Nestled in a quiet community, this home offers a spacious layout, a screened-in porch, and modern furnishings. Enjoy easy access to top dining, shopping, and outdoor adventures along 30A. With bikes provided and a community pool nearby, your perfect coastal getaway awaits!.css-1ji0eah{margin-top:var(--chakra-space-8);position:relative;}.css-1q2slen{max-height:100px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;}.css-brfu0{font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.8;white-space:pre-line;}.css-6qgo7l{display:-webkit-box;display:-webkit-flex;display:-ms-flexbox;display:flex;-webkit-align-items:flex-start;-webkit-box-align:flex-start;-ms-flex-align:flex-start;align-items:flex-start;-webkit-flex-direction:column;-ms-flex-direction:column;flex-direction:column;margin-bottom:var(--chakra-space-12);}.css-16qsgd1{line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-0.025em;font-size:var(--chakra-fontSizes-xl);font-weight:400;font-family:var(--chakra-fonts-body);color:var(--chakra-colors-primary-800);}Space.css-1wz6mgq{opacity:0.6;border:0;border-style:solid;border-bottom-width:1px;width:100%;border-color:var(--chakra-colors-gray-200);}.css-1wz6mgq{margin-top:0.5rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;-webkit-margin-start:0px;margin-inline-start:0px;-webkit-margin-end:0px;margin-inline-end:0px;border-left-width:0;border-bottom-width:1px;}.css-5ww9bs{font-size:var(--chakra-fontSizes-md);margin-top:var(--chakra-space-3);color:var(--chakra-colors-primary-600);}Welcome to "A Wave From It All" —a perfect retreat for those seeking to unplug, reset, and reconnect. This pristine newer beach home invites you to slow down and savor the simple joys, featuring designer furnishings, a fully equipped kitchen, and a cozy screened-in porch that’s perfect for unwinding after a day spent on the sand or exploring. Nestled just steps from popular Avenue 30A, you’ll be within walking or biking distance of local cafes, boutiques, and artisanal shops. Four bikes are provided, letting you effortlessly roam through the picturesque area, with easy access to nearby beaches and a new pedestrian tunnel that opens up a smooth ride to the charming scenes of Rosemary Beach. "A Wave From It All" is designed for those special moments—whether it’s sharing stories over a meal, discovering local treasures, or simply being present in the natural beauty of the Emerald Coast. Reconnect with family, friends, and the world around you, and find true relaxation by the shore. TRANSPORTATION - 4 Adult bikes are included with this rental. If more are needed, a discount code at a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information. HELPUFL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - The Preserve at Inlet Beach has a community pool with pavilion and outdoor fireplace - Community boardwalk & dock provides direct access to Lake Powell for kayaking and paddle boarding 1 block away BEACH ACCESS - There is public beach access 0.7 miles - Camp Helen State Park - 1.8 miles SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 9) - PRIMARY BEDROOM: 1st Floor with King bed, TV, Private Bath with walk-in shower - QUEEN BEDROOM: 2nd Floor with Queen bed, TV, Private Bath with tub/shower - QUEEN BEDROOM: 2nd Floor with Queen bed, TV, Shared Bath with walk-in shower - BUNK ROOM: 2nd Floor with Twin over Double Bunk, TV, Shared Bath with walk-in shower SHOPPING, DINING & ENTERTAINMENT - Seaside – 10 miles - Alys Beach – 1.8 miles - Rosemary Beach – 1 mile - Shades Bar & Grill – 0.4 mile - 30Avenue – 500 ft - Publix Shopping Center – 3 miles - Winn-Dixie and CVS Pharmacy – 3 miles - Pier Park at Panama City Beach – 10 miles SECURITY - Smart doorbell - Security cameras are positioned at entry points FEATURES - 4 Bedroom, 3.5 Bathroom Home - Sleeps 9 (King, Queen, Queen Twin over Double) - Private screened porch overlooking private, fenced back yard - Fully appointed kitchen - Full Sized refrigerator, 5 burner cooktop, full sized oven - Gas Grill - Full sized washer & dryer - Parking for 3 cars in driveway - Large community pool with pavilion, outdoor fireplace - Newer home with designer furnishings - TV in each bedroom, one in upstairs children's loft, one in 1st floor family room
